notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 21, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 21, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Removed leftover development cube used for vault testing.

Fixed stuck markers in the navigation compass, now removed correctly.

Fixed a terrain pit near the village where the player could get permanently stuck.

Adjusted combat tutorial behavior on Steam Deck, skip functionality should now work (needs testing).

Intro video quality modified to improve stability on specific setups.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 20, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 20, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where the Combat Tutorial wasn't being removed properly.

Followers could stop fighting during the first combat encounter, this has been resolved.

Steam Deck button mappings have been adjusted for better compatibility.

Opening cutscenes have been reworked to prevent game crashes.

🆕 New Content & Features:
New Follower Commands: The player can now issue the following orders on "L"
Follow, Combat, Move, and Wait.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 17, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 17, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Combat tutorial now properly pauses the game. The Q key to skip works and displays correctly across all resolutions.

Combat tutorial videos have been replaced with lower-performance-demand versions.

Fixed a bug where quickly skipping both intro cutscenes could freeze the game. There’s now a 3-second delay between skips.

Adjusted jump height while sprinting.

SteamDeck Support:

Left Shoulder (LB): Block & Parry

D-Pad Up: Open/close map

Face Button Top (Y): Skip cutscene

Left Thumbstick Press: Walk slowly

UI fix: Checkbox now correctly displays checked/unchecked states.

Map UI fix - M key now works immediately without needing a mouse click.

Pause menu: cursor and input focus issues resolved.

Fixed a shout line at the Greyvale vendor.

Fixed mouse and keyboard focus issues in UI interactions.

🆕 New Content & Features:
Combat tutorial videos now included in lower quality.

First version of the Quality Preset button added to graphics settings.

🚀 Optimizations
Improved performance - increased FPS and reduced CPU/GPU usage.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 16, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 16, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Followers no longer block the entrance inside the main building thanks to the newly added wait point.

Fixed an issue in the Combat Tutorial where enemies would start chasing the player during a paused game.

Fixed missing diacritics in the dialogue between Štěpán and Halrik during Stage 2.

Increased the size of quest markers to prevent players from unintentionally running past them and needing to backtrack to progress the quest.

🆕 New Content & Features:
Added a Wait Point system for followers when the player enters the main building.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 15, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 15, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Changed graphics preset from “LOW” to “Medium (Minimum)”.

Followers no longer block the main building door in the village.

Fixed issue where the game would freeze for a few seconds after two consecutive cutscenes.

Fixed bug where Halrik would speak between cutscenes.

Adjusted launch velocity values during jumping, now behaves realistically.

Fixed rendering glitch where water appeared under the player character in the inventory.

🆕 New Content & Features:
New cutscene: Morning in the Camp.

Added the ability to skip cutscenes using the Q key.

Updated font for damage indicators.

New Intro added.

Added a Combat Tutorial before the first fight.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 9, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 9, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Edran no longer drifts after the dialogue with Halrik in stage 2.

Fixed enemy spawn timing in the village.

Fixed enemy spawn timing at the castle.

Map marker for Brint is now correctly named Brint instead of NPC.

Map marker for Halrik is now correctly named Halrik instead of NPC.

Map marker for Calwen is now correctly named Calwen instead of NPC.

Map marker for Stepan is now correctly named Stepan instead of NPC.

Adjusted LOW graphics settings, the visuals now look significantly better.

🆕 New Content & Features:
When interacting to push a follower, the pushed follower now checks behind for another follower and pushes them too, creating a chain reaction.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 8, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 8, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Temporarily removed the "Reload Game" button from the Pause Menu - currently unnecessary until the save/load system is complete.

Fixed perception bug on the Captain that caused combat music to never stop.

Fixed an animation issue during the Reeve dialogue where Edran entered a T-pose - now plays correctly.

Minor adjustments to Edran's final animations.

Reduced volume of villagers - they were overpowering dialogue lines.

Removed effects from one-handed, two-handed sword, and arrows - creating a more realistic feel.

Removed effects from unarmed (fist) attacks.

Fixed follower combat sounds and voice lines - now respect distance properly.

Narrator now pauses the game correctly, ensuring the player starts with the correct camera.

Brint no longer gets stuck with Štěpán at the campfire during stage 1.

Launcher icon is no longer blurry.

Increased follower movement speed to better match Edran.

Replaced or removed dozens of poorly performing animations.

Added a new background to the main menu, fixing flickering at the bottom.

Fixed an issue where Edran could get stuck in the campfire after a dialogue with Halrik.

Changed the map player marker name from "Default" to "Edran".

Fixed a pit near Erenwald castle that could trap the player.

Corrected socket positions and rotations for bow, sword, greatsword, and shield - now display properly on both player and followers.

Updated follower push: now mapped to the interaction key "E".

Fixed firepit issue: Edran no longer gets stuck during or after talking to Halrik.

Aim mode can now only be activated with bow equipped - no longer triggers during heavy attack or slow walk.

Narrator pause extended slightly to prevent audio bugs.

Halved interaction radius - feels more grounded.

New location discovery widget no longer overlaps navigation bar.

🆕 New Content & Features:
A narrator system as placeholder for demo cutscenes.

Push function added for followers (e.g. to clear doorways).

Subtitles added for NPC voice shouts when taking or dealing damage.

Increased fall damage - now feels more realistic.

Map can now be opened using the M key.

Holding Left Ctrl now enables slow walking.

🚀 Performance:
~20% CPU frame time optimization.

Reduced number of unnecessarily ticking actors.

Lowered per-frame animations on non-critical objects.

Optimized CPU usage for animation, perception, and blueprint tick systems.

Stabilized grooming system.

notes.title: 🛠️ Changelog (July 4, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Changelog (July 4, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Combat music system updated. Needs to be verified in the Play Test. It should now work consistently.

Added invisible barriers around Lord Alric to prevent unintended bugs during combat. Corrected floor collision.

Dialogue animations now transition much more naturally into the idle pose at the end.

Fixed facial animations for Edran (Player) – now fully functional.

Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck on a rock after finishing the dialogue with the first villager.

Temporarily removed the Reload Game button from the pause menu. It will be reintroduced once the save/load system is fully functional.

🆕 New Content & Features:
Added facial animations for Edran (Player) in all dialogues.

Added missing full-body animations for Edran in all stages of the demo.

Added a narrator system to replace cutscenes in the demo version of the game.

notes.title: 🛠 Changelog (July 1, 2025)
notes.notes:
🛠 Changelog (July 1, 2025)
✅ Bug Fixes:
Combat Music Manager now works correctly. Previously, it required the presence of a follower/companion to trigger combat music. Perception logic has been fixed.

Fixed an issue where followers and villagers could interrupt active player dialogues.

🆕 New Content & Features:
The development placeholder blood effect has been removed and replaced with a realistic blood impact effect.

Added bleeding, which can randomly occur when taking damage.

Added a blood decal effect on the ground when a character is bleeding.

Added blood splatter effect on the enemy when taking damage.

Currently added for testing on enemy soldiers only.

notes.title: 🛠 Hotfix Changelog (June 29, 2025)
notes.notes:
🔧 Bug Fixes:
The background in the main menu sometimes failed to display. This issue has been resolved, and the background quality has also been improved.

🆕 New Content & Features:
A narrator has been added at the beginning of the game to provide key informations.
